rule: Additive governance record, not a new research baseline. The original frozen baselines stay authoritative. scripts/political-data/germany/frozen-boundary.mjs accepts a pnpm-lock.yaml that differs from a baseline only when its sha256 equals new_lockfile_sha256 of an approved entry AND package.json differs from the baseline only by the listed package/version pairs AND no other dependency-tooling file changed. Any later lockfile change needs a new owner-approved entry.

exceptions.reason: Security maintenance only: Next.js advisories fixed in 16.2.11 / 16.3.3 / 16.3.6 (bundled postcss and sharp advisories included); in-range transitive refresh of browserslist, baseline-browser-mapping, brace-expansion and js-yaml.
exceptions.notes: Exact one-time dependency maintenance exception. See docs/legal-security/third_party_dependency_licences.md.
